title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About Turnkey

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.

The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! We have employees located in Eastern European countries and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay). We continue scaling remote software development teams for more than 30+ US-based enterprises and start-ups, including Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, Ironclad, BellXcel, etc. At TurnKey, we’re the ultimate matchmakers for US-based companies, creating remote dream teams.


Role Overview

We’re looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. You will play a key role in sourcing and recruiting top tech and non-tech talent across Europe and Latin America , partnering closely with hiring managers and candidates to ensure an excellent recruitment experience from start to finish.


Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal teams and clients to understand hiring needs and role requirements
  • Source, screen, and engage candidates for a variety of technical and non-technical roles
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment: job posting, sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates’ time zone


Why You Should Work at TurnKey:

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks);
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Free advanced English lessons with a budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work;
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes.
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)


About Sisense

Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.


With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence and the Intelligence Assistant, we are accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance.


Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense’s growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning.


Requirements

  • 3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.


How You’ll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team’s revenue retention and growth goals.


What We Offer

  • Employment through a partner agency (B2B).
  • Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience).
  • Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus.
  • Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics.
  • Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team.
  • Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

Job Title: Backend/ Integration Developer

Experience : 5+ Years

Location : Remote -Brazil

Language : Fluent/Advanced English

Integration Developer – IBM App Connect (ESB)

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Integration Developer with strong expertise in IBM App

Connect Enterprise (ACE) to design, develop, and deliver scalable integration solutions

across global enterprise platforms.

This role is part of the Global Integration Engineering team and focuses on enabling API-led,

event-driven, and cloud-native integrations that support enterprise digital transformation

initiatives. The ideal candidate brings a strong integration mindset, hands-on ESB

experience, and working knowledge of cloud platforms, automation, and modern

development practices.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design and develop cloud-ready and hybrid integration solutions using IBM App

Connect / ACE.

• Build and expose RESTful APIs, event-driven services, and asynchronous integrations

aligned to enterprise architecture standards.

• Implement modern integration patterns including API-led connectivity, event

streaming, pub/sub, and request–reply.

• Develop integrations that are secure, scalable, resilient, and observable in cloud and

hybrid environments.

• Work closely with architects to evolve integration standards and support cloud

adoption and modernization initiatives.

• Integrate enterprise systems using messaging, APIs, file transfer, and streaming

technologies.

• Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and infrastructure-aware

integration design.

• Support non-functional requirements including performance, high availability,

disaster recovery, and security.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Cloud, DevOps, Security, QA, Product, and

Business).

• Participate in troubleshooting, production support, and continuous improvement of

integration platforms.

• Provide technical guidance and promote best practices across the integration

community.

• Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, and adoption of integration best

practices across the organization.

Core Skills & Experience (Required)

• Strong hands-on experience with IBM App Connect Enterprise (ACE) / IBM

Integration Bus (IIB).

• Proven expertise in:

o ESQL, DFDL

o REST & SOAP APIs

o JSON, XML, XSLT

o IBM MQ, JMS, HTTP/S

• Deep understanding of enterprise and cloud integration patterns.

• Experience designing integrations for high availability, scalability, and fault tolerance.

• Working knowledge of cloud platforms i.e. AWS

• Experience building or consuming cloud-native services and APIs.

• Programming experience in Java, including scripting and automation.

• Familiarity with Git-based version control and collaborative development workflows.

Nice to Have / Desirable Skills

• IIB / ACE certifications.

• Experience with MuleSoft or ETL or data integration tools (e.g., Informatica).

• Unix/Linux and shell scripting.

• Experience supporting global, large-scale enterprise platforms

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação II
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro , maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina , e a Fisia , distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades:


-Monitoramento e Resposta (SOC): Atuar como ponto focal em incidentes críticos, realizando análise forense inicial e contenção de ameaças;

- Engenharia de Detecção (SIEM): Criar, tunar e otimizar regras de correlação no SIEM para reduzir falsos positivos e aumentar a visibilidade sobre ataques modernos;

- Inteligência de Ameaças (Threat Intel): Coletar e analisar IOCs (Indicadores de Comprometimento) e TTPs (Táticas, Técnicas e Procedimentos), convertendo inteligência bruta em ações de defesa proativa;

- Gestão de Vulnerabilidades: Liderar o ciclo de vida de vulnerabilidades, desde a varredura e priorização (baseada em risco e exploitability) até o acompanhamento da remediação com os times de infraestrutura e dev;

- Hunting: Realizar buscas proativas por ameaças que possam ter passado despercebidas pelos controles automáticos.


Requisitos Técnicos:

- SIEM: Experiência avançada em plataformas como Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic Security ou QRadar (criação de dashboards e KQL/SPL);

- Frameworks: Domínio do MITRE ATT&CK e NIST Incident Response;

- Threat Intel: Conhecimento em plataformas de TI (MISP, OpenCTI) e consumo de feeds de inteligência;

- Vulnerability Management: Operação de ferramentas como Tenable.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando ser seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões em rodada de investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


Como é trabalhar na TM?

Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho livre e flexível, por isso, a confiança é a base de tudo que fazemos. Aqui, precisamos de pessoas comprometidas e prontas para novos desafios, capazes de desbravar o agronegócio e nos ajudar na nossa principal missão: levar para o agronegócio o insumo mais importante: o crédito.


Dia a dia

  • Contribuir ativamente para a criação e evolução de produtos e serviços no universo de Crédito e Risco.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de negócios para entender requisitos de dados e entregar soluções técnicas avançadas.
  • Desenvolver pipelines robustos de ingestão de dados massivos (batch, near real-time e real-time), garantindo confiabilidade e eficiência.
  • Assegurar que a arquitetura de dados esteja alinhada com os objetivos do negócio.
  • Trabalhar com equipes multifuncionais para integrar dados em nossos produtos e serviços.
  • Identificar oportunidades para aquisição de novos dados e propor melhorias contínuas em disponibilidade, confiabilidade e eficiência.
  • Facilitar a democratização dos dados em toda a empresa.
  • Compreender profundamente os produtos e serviços da TerraMagna para melhor atender às necessidades internas.
  • Manter-se atualizado com tendências e melhores práticas em Engenharia e Ciência de Dados.


Requisitos

  • 5+ anos de experiência em engenharia de dados e/ou desenvolvimento de software, com ênfase em grandes volumes de dados e alta disponibilidade.
  • Forte domínio de Python (nível produção) e SQL avançado (modelagem, performance, manipulação de grandes volumes).
  • Experiência prática na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados batch e near real-time.
  • Experiência com mensageria e processamento de eventos (Pub/Sub, Kafka ou similares).
  • Experiência com orquestração de workflows (Airflow ou similar).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de transformação de dados (dbt ou similar).
  • Experiência em ambientes de nuvem, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP) .
  • Versionamento de código com Git/GitHub .
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou similar).
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de modelagem de dados (dimensional, relacional, data vault), particionamento e otimização de queries.
  • Boas habilidades de comunicação e colaboração com times técnicos e de negócio.
  • Perfil proativo, orientado a resultados e com forte capacidade de resolução de problemas.
  • Interesse genuíno em evoluir tecnicamente em um ambiente dinâmico de fintech.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com BigQuery , Kubernetes (GKE) , Cloud Storage , Pub/Sub e Docker .
  • Familiaridade com dbt , Dataform ou ferramentas similares de transformação de dados.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados em múltiplas camadas (raw, trusted, refined, datamart).
  • Experiência com integração de APIs externas ou ingestão de dados não estruturados.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos e ferramentas de Lakehouse (Delta Lake, Databricks, Cloudera).
  • Experiência com Spark , Flink ou frameworks de processamento distribuído.
  • Experiência no setor de serviços financeiros ou em projetos relacionados a crédito e risco.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI e Data Apps (Streamlit, Tableau, Qlik).

title: [Tech] Agile Sênior
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Atuar como facilitador e agente de transformação ágil, promovendo a cultura de melhoria contínua e fortalecendo a colaboração entre os times. Seu papel será apoiar equipes multifuncionais na adoção e maturidade de práticas ágeis, além de impulsionar a eficiência dos processos e o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da organização.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Capacitar e treinar pessoas em ferramentas, métodos e processos ágeis, promovendo o conhecimento contínuo e a autonomia dos times;
  • Atuar como agente de mudança, questionando e provocando reflexões que fomentem o crescimento coletivo;
  • Praticar escuta ativa, acolhendo e auxiliando nas questões individuais dos membros do time;
  • Apoiar as squads na construção de senso de pertencimento e na busca por alta performance;
  • Implementar práticas e ferramentas ágeis de acordo com o contexto e maturidade dos times;
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis, workshops de ideação, resolução de problemas e retrospectivas;
  • Gerenciar métricas relacionadas à eficiência dos processos e à saúde cultural dos times;
  • Estruturar processos de rotina e gestão do conhecimento para garantir a fluidez do trabalho;
  • Ajudar os times na construção e condução de processos de experimentação e validação de hipóteses;
  • Identificar pontos de melhoria e gargalos no dia a dia das squads, atuando de forma colaborativa para solucioná-los;
  • Apoiar a estruturação e reorganização de tribos, promovendo sinergia entre as equipes;
  • Remover impedimentos e garantir que os times tenham um ambiente propício à entrega de valor.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Lean, XP);
  • Conhecimento em OKRs e práticas de gestão como Management 3.0;
  • Técnicas de facilitação e dinâmicas colaborativas;
  • Experiência em mapeamento, análise e melhoria de processos;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de acompanhamento ágil (Jira, Confluence, Miro, etc.);
  • Habilidade para atuar com métricas de performance e cultura de times.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Certificações em metodologias ágeis (CSM, PSM, KMP, ICP-ATF, etc.);
  • Experiência como Agile Coach ou em ambientes com múltiplas squads;
  • Vivência com escalabilidade ágil (SAFe, LeSS, Spotify model);
  • Experiência em contextos de transformação digital e/ou cultural;
  • Conhecimento em cultura DevOps e Design Thinking.
  • Desejável atuação com diferentes perfis de equipes (tecnologia, produto, negócios) e em iniciativas de mudança cultural ou estrutural.


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

title: Comprador(a) Sênior - (Serviços industriais e logísticos)
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú


O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.


Desafio:


Garantir a aquisição de serviços industriais e logísticos, acompanhando os processos sob sua responsabilidade, mantendo relacionamento próximo aos clientes internos, assegurando as melhores práticas de negociação, otimizando processos de compras, custos e prazos de atendimento a demanda, ratificando o cumprimento das regras de compliance em todo o processo.


Principais Atividades:


  • Realizar cotações, negociações e contratações de serviços industriais e logísticos, incluindo transporte rodoviário(industrial/florestal), armazenagem, movimentação e operações terceirizadas, aplicando as abordagens ao mercado e estratégia de negociação mais aderentes;
  • Desenvolver e manter parcerias estratégicas com clientes internos, bem como áreas de suporte da Arauco; - Prospectar fornecedores de Serviços Industriais e Logísticos, através de avaliações criteriosas, visando garantir atendimento aos padrões de qualidade, segurança e capacidade operacional;
  • Construir parcerias estratégicas de longo prazo com fornecedores e prestadores de Serviços Industriais e Logísticos, através da negociação de acordos de nível de serviço (SLAs), formalização e validação de contratos, quando aplicável, assegurando as melhores práticas e buscando iniciativas para mitigação de aumento de preços e otimização dos custos;
  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vida dos contratos, incluindo prazos de vigência, cláusulas de renovação e compliance com os termos contratuais;
  • Realizar a gestão da carteira de requisições, planejando o atendimento das demandas de forma assertiva e eficiente - Realizar as negociações conforme as estratégias e procedimentos de otimização dos custos das compras de sua responsabilidade;
  • Aplicar estratégia de sourcing, visando a diversificação de fornecedores, para reduzir riscos de descontinuidade do fornecimento de serviços, materiais e equipamentos;
  • Participar e apoiar projetos, inovação, modificações e modernização de sistemas e processos relacionados a área de Suprimentos; - Elaborar e propor de planos de contingência para as compras críticas de sua responsabilidade, mapeando, avaliando e mitigando os impactos diretos a Arauco;

description:
Job Title: Wireless Network Optimization Engineer (4G/5G)

Job Summary:

The RF Network Optimization Engineer is responsible for improving the performance, capacity, and quality of mobile networks (LTE/4G and NR/5G). This role involves analyzing network KPIs, identifying issues, and implementing optimization strategies to enhance user experience and network efficiency.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor and analyze network performance KPIs (e.g., accessibility, retainability, mobility, throughput)
  • Perform optimization for 4G LTE and 5G NR networks
  • Conduct drive tests and post-processing analysis using tools like TEMS, Nemo, or similar
  • Identify coverage and capacity issues and propose solutions (tilt, azimuth, parameter tuning)
  • Optimize parameters such as handovers, power control, load balancing, and interference mitigation
  • Support network rollout, integration, and acceptance activities
  • Analyze OSS data and generate performance reports
  • Work closely with RF planning, transmission, and core network teams
  • Troubleshoot customer complaints and network degradation issues
  • Ensure SLA compliance and continuous network improvement


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or related field
  • Experience with RF optimization and performance tuning
  • Experience with major vendors (Huawei, Ericsson, Nokia, ZTE) is a plus
  • 3–7+ years in wireless network optimization or RF engineering
  • Advanced English
  • Work on site mode


Soft Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good communication and reporting abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
  • Team collaboration and stakeholder management

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Who We Are: We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


The 3 G’s of RE:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”

  • You are a team player, self-driven, highly motivated individual who loves to learn new things


Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus

title: ANALISTA MERCHANDISING/BUYER
description:
A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.


⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO


Responsável por realizar compra das coleções e acompanhamento dos indicadores da área de produto, como OTB, compras, vendas, cash flow, margem, Sell Thru e Loss end. Garantir a correta precificação e alocação de produtos na loja, bem como treinamento para equipe de loja. Ter contato direto com a loja e demais áreas que possuem interação para garantir o alinhamento 360° em relação a produto e a otimização da venda/giro. Responsável pela movimentaçao entre estoques, garantindo a acuracidade da oferta em cada canal. Responsável pela interface com o Iguatemi365, no que tange aos kpis da área: oferta, precificação, disponibilidade de produtos, giro, venda por produto.


RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?


Realizar a concepção do OTB (open to buy) diante da projeção e vendas determinada, considerando marca, coleções, categorias, subcategorias, itens, grade. Para acuracidade, deve considerar analise de histórico e tendências.

Realizar o processo de compra de produtos. Receber material da nova coleção, entender a inspiração junto a marca, analisar vendas e definir qual será o investimento de cada categoria (+subcategoria, itens, grade). Avaliar tendências e integrar equipe de varejo na definição dos produtos.

Realizar a precificação de produtos em linha com as premissas definidas e alinhadas com a marca e internamente determinadas pela iRetail. Sugerir as premissas adequadas para cada marca e momento, para tanto é necessário entender o mercado, analisar concorrência, para garantir que atingiremos os resultados definidos em budget.

Estar frequentemente em loja para acompanhar as vendas dos produtos junto à equipe de loja (in loco na loja), olhar tanto quantitativo quanto qualitativo, avaliar a exposição dos mesmos, reforçar o treinamento da equipe sobre a marca e os produtos. Propor sugestões de ações internas para melhoria do giro dos produtos (kpi); conectar frequentemente com Varejo e Marketing para discutir oportunidade e viabilidade de ações. Proatividade na busca de soluções para melhor girar produto.

Acompanhar o mercado de varejo, como ações e preços de concorrentes. Fazer uma análise crítica com relação ao que estamos praticando e, se necessário, propor mudanças.

Responsável pelo conhecimento das informações relacionadas a produto, assim como o treinamento da equipe. Garantir o conhecimento de todos os envolvidos no prazo necessário para que consigam agir em suas respectivas áreas.

Conhecer as clientes das marcas sob sua responsabilidade (grau de relacionamento de acordo com a tipo de cliente, construir relacionamento com as marcas)

Garantir junto a área de Operações o recebimento dos produtos nos prazos necessários. Acompanhar todos os embarques e entender impactos de possíveis atrasos nos recebimentos e lidar com o Controle de Qualidade (processos, interface loja, com a marca e solicitar os devidos reembolsos).

Participar e contribuir em ações da marca (como eventos etc), garantindo excelência e ganho de conhecimento.


Garantir acuracidade nas informações quantitativas e qualitativas, na frequência demandada.

Disponibilidade para viajar para os markets das marcas - frequência tbc.

title: Comprador(a) Júnior - (Serviços industriais e logísticos)
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú


O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.


Desafio:


Garantir a aquisição de serviços, acompanhando os processos sob sua responsabilidade, mantendo relacionamento próximo aos clientes internos, assegurando as melhores práticas de negociação, otimizando processos de compras, custos e prazos de atendimento a demanda, ratificando o cumprimento das regras de compliance em todo o processo.

title: Industrial Director (Senador Canedo/GO)
description:
ABOUT COTY


Coty is one of the world’s largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skincare, and body care brands. At Coty, we celebrate and nurture a culture of kindness. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We believe that beauty lies in diversity and are committed to continuing to build an environment where all talents can thrive. We deeply value the unique contributions each individual brings to our team. As part of our commitment to inclusion, all profiles are welcome.


MISSION


Lead and transform site manufacturing activities by strategically managing resources and people to maximize performance across cost, quality, productivity, service levels, safety, and environmental sustainability. As a key executive leader, you will define and implement the strategic direction for the manufacturing unit, ensuring continuous improvement and operational excellence aligned with global company needs.


RESPONSIBILITIES


Strategic Development & Vision

  • Determine the short, medium, and long-term strategic direction for the manufacturing site, focusing on people, processes, and management methods to drive efficiency and profitability.
  • Connect the site’s vision to the organizational culture through a Compelling Business Need (CBN).
  • Direct and restructure the manufacturing unit's strategic alignment to optimize resources and processes.


Operational Excellence & Management Systems

  • Guarantee the systematic implementation of a Manufacturing Management System based on Lean 6 Sigma and TPM methodologies.
  • Establish a high-performance culture centered on safety, quality, results, process control, and standardization.
  • Implement and oversee a robust maintenance management system to ensure equipment reliability, availability, and cost evolution.
  • Manage the site performance through KPIs deployed at the operational level, ensuring regular monitoring (daily, monthly, annually) and corrective actions for any deviations.


Financial Stewardship & Innovation

  • Elaborate and manage the area budget using Zero-Based Budgeting (OBZ) principles to optimize production processes and reduce costs.
  • Lead CAPEX and replacement management for the manufacturing unit, ensuring investments align with Industry 4.0 concepts and basic condition restoration.
  • Support innovation processes and cost-reduction projects by ensuring feasibility and resource availability within planned timelines.


Team Leadership & Capability Building

  • Lead a multidisciplinary team, fostering engagement, accountability, and high performance.
  • Form a high-performance team through a structured Skills Matrix aligned with the company’s long-term objectives.
  • Build a solid succession plan and provide continuous feedback to develop leadership and technical competencies.


REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS


  • Higher education degree with a mandatory Post-Graduate or MBA specialization.
  • Experience: Minimum of 9+ years of proven experience in large-scale industrial environments.
  • Advanced English is required for frequent interaction with global teams.
  • Deep knowledge in TPM, Lean 6 Sigma, Maintenance Management, and Industrial Cost Management.
  • Advanced proficiency in SAP (or similar ERP) and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Must be able to work 100% On-site in Senador Canedo / GO, Brazil .

Full-time | Remote | English CV


ABOUT ROLE:


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team and help drive and accelerate our growth. We offer a competitive salary and a fully remote work environment.


You will be working on a fintech platform focused on retirement savings, designed to simplify and improve how businesses offer retirement plans to their employees.


The platform helps companies — especially small and mid-sized businesses — provide accessible and well-structured retirement plans through modern technology. The solution automates investing, simplifies administration, and offers transparent pricing without hidden fees.


This project delivers a complete retirement plan solution with built-in compliance and regulatory support, making it easier for employers to offer strong financial benefits to their teams.


If you are passionate about building impactful financial technology and want to work in a fast-growing environment where your work directly improves financial well-being, this is a great opportunity to make a real difference.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Architect and scale our FinTech platform: Lead the design and evolution of our robust, cloud-based platform, ensuring scalability, security, and performance.
  • Work with high performing global teams: Collaborate with our Europe-based engineering counterparts, fostering a culture of timely, on-budget delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Demand operational excellence: Implement best practices across technical operations, ensuring reliability, efficiency, and seamless execution.
  • Ensure platform integrity and compliance: Conduct/lead code audits to guarantee adherence to compliance standards and mathematical precision in all calculations.
  • Champion AI-driven innovation: Identify and integrate cutting-edge AI solutions to enhance our platform offerings and optimize development processes.
  • Collaborate across the organization: Partner closely with business and client-facing teams to gather insights, define product specifications, and prioritize initiatives to align with business and customer goals.
  • Embody decisive leadership: Own critical decisions, demonstrate strong accountability and ethics, and inspire confidence through clear communication and unwavering commitment.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 6+ years of experience as a Backend Engineer or similar role.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and experience with modern Python development practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (version 20 or higher) and Docker Compose for local development and deployment.
  • Experience with UV for Python package and environment management.
  • Solid understanding of database concepts and strong experience with PostgreSQL, including writing efficient queries and managing migrations with Alembic.

title: Atendente de farmácia
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Vem conferir!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Cumprimentar os clientes de forma cortês e prestativa, ajudando a esclarecer dúvidas, fornecendo informações sobre produtos, incluindo dosagem, uso e possíveis efeitos colaterais.
  • Dispensação de Medicamentos: Dispensar medicamentos prescritos com precisão, seguindo os regulamentos e procedimentos da farmácia. Certificar-se de que os pacientes recebam as orientações adequadas sobre o uso de medicamentos.
  • Vendas e Registro de Vendas: Realizar vendas de produtos de venda livre e registrar as transações com precisão. Processar pagamentos em dinheiro, cartão de crédito ou outros métodos de pagamento aceitos pela farmácia.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Verificar regularmente o estoque de medicamentos e produtos, repor itens conforme necessário e garantir que os produtos estejam dentro do prazo de validade. Manter registros precisos de estoque.
  • Conhecimento de Produtos: Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos disponíveis na farmácia, incluindo suas características, benefícios e possíveis interações medicamentosas.
  • Atendimento Telefônico: Atender chamadas telefônicas de forma profissional, responder a perguntas dos clientes.
  • Organização: Manter a área de atendimento ao cliente e as prateleiras organizadas. Garantir que produtos perigosos sejam armazenados adequadamente e de acordo com as normas de segurança.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Conhecimento em Informática Básica;
  • Desejável experiência como operador de caixa e atendimento ao cliente.
  • Disponibilidade de trabalhar em escala 6x1.
  • Que Pode Ser Um Diferencial
  • Experiência como operador de caixa e atendimento ao cliente.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios

  • Vale-transporte;
  • Plano de Saúde por elegibilidade por localidade e cargo;
  • Plano Odontológico por adesão;
  • Seguro de vida e Assistência Funeral;
  • Plataforma de terapia online;
  • Programa de Gestantes;
  • Convênios Educacionais com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e dependentes;
  • Universidade Corporativa Pague Menos com cursos e treinamentos - Up Farma;
  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos;
  • Convênio Farmácia, com desconto em folha de pagamento - Epharma;

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

VEM SER GENTE QUE FAZ BEM!

Na história da Pague Menos , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Promover o acesso à saúde significa ampliar liberdade, cuidado e qualidade de vida para milhões de brasileiros. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita por gente que faz bem e que está comprometida em levar saúde com amor pra todos os brasileiros. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país e, hoje, somos quase 1.700 lojas e mais de 28 mil colaboradores que formam uma comunidade diversa que cresce junto e trabalha com impacto real na vida das pessoas.

Nossa história começou em 1981, com a abertura da primeira loja em Fortaleza (CE). Desde então, seguimos crescendo com base na valorização das pessoas, no foco no cliente, na sustentabilidade, na integridade, na superação dos resultados e na inovação em soluções de saúde. Hoje somos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil , que é fruto de uma estratégia que combina eficiência, proximidade com o cliente e fortalecimento dos nossos consultórios farmacêuticos.

Nosso modelo de negócio une produtos, serviços e cuidado contínuo. Atuamos no varejo de especialidade com o conceito de drugstore e evoluímos para um hub integrado de saúde.

Trabalhar aqui é fazer parte de um ambiente que valoriza a diversidade, incentiva a autenticidade e acredita no poder da colaboração. É um lugar para crescer, contribuir e gerar impacto todos os dias. Bora juntos?

description:
Job Title - AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents)


About the Company

Our client is a US-based AI startup building production AI agents for marketing workflows (SEO, social media, email). The team is led by experienced founders with backgrounds at Meta, Google, and Scale AI.

This is a product engineering role, not research. You’ll build AI agents that ship, scale, and are used by real customers.


About the Role

We’re looking for a hands-on AI Product Engineer who can own features end-to-end: frontend, backend, and AI logic.

You will build AI agents inside real products, not demos — working closely with the CTO and founders to design, implement, and iterate quickly.


What You’ll Do

  • Build AI-powered product features using React (frontend) and Django (backend)
  • Implement LLM-based agents that perform real business workflows
  • Design and maintain RAG pipelines (retrieval, chunking, embeddings, evaluation)
  • Integrate third-party APIs, web scraping, and internal data sources
  • Own features from idea → production → iteration
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions in a fast-moving startup environment


Must-Have Requirements

  • 6+ years total engineering experience
  • 4+ years of professional experience as a software / product engineer
  • 2+ years working with LLMs, AI agents, or generative AI systems
  • Strong hands-on experience with React (frontend) and Django (backend)
  • Proven experience building AI agents or LLM-powered features used in production


Solid understanding of RAG systems, including:

  • Retrieval quality tradeoffs
  • Chunking strategies
  • Hallucination risks and mitigation
  • Comfortable working without heavy frameworks or abstractions
  • Able to explain technical decisions clearly, concretely, and concisely
  • Startup mindset: moves fast, owns outcomes, and ships
  • Experience with Pinecone, pgvector, or similar vector databases
  • Web scraping, data ingestion pipelines, or third-party API integrations
  • Prior experience in marketing, SEO, or growth-related products


Logistics

  • Full-time (40 hrs/week). US Time Zones
  • Starting ASAP

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Role Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Your mission->

I. Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer


Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.


You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.


What you’ll do

  • You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
  • Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
  • Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
  • Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
  • Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
  • Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
  • Edit video for social distribution and website use
  • Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative
  • This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.


What matters in this role

  • You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
  • You understand how design actually shows up in B2B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
  • You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
  • You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
  • You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks


Requirements

  • 4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
  • Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
  • Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
  • Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video)
  • Video editing experience for social and web content
  • Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite


Context for the work

Our client sells to B2B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:

  • Driving registrations and product demos
  • Increasing engagement
  • Supporting sales follow-up
  • Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders

The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.


What this is not

  • Not a pure brand exploration role
  • Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment
  • Not isolated design work handed over a wall


You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.


If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

title: Account Manager
description:
As an Account Manager for Brazil , you'll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You'll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our content and product departments.


You'll be responsible for driving the entire sales and success cycle in the iGaming market, from initial engagement to maximizing long-term results. Managing key client relationships, driving sales growth, and ensuring customer satisfaction within these specific regions. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, understanding client needs, and delivering tailored solutions that drive mutual success.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including sports betting operators, casinos, online gaming platforms, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts, managing all aspects of the client relationship and serving as their trusted advisor.
  • Understand clients' business objectives, market trends, and regulatory requirements specific to the English speaking markets to effectively position our gambling products and services.
  • Collaborate with internal sales, marketing, and product development teams to customize solutions and address client needs within these regions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional products/services and expanding client accounts.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and business cases to key clients within these regions.
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and optimization within key accounts.
  • Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments.
  • Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management.
  • Stay up-to-date on gambling regulations, compliance standards, and responsible gaming practices to ensure adherence and mitigate risks.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions.
  • Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth.
  • Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management.
  • Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners.
  • Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
  • Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media

title: Administrative Manager
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!



ABOUT THE ROLE

Responsibilities

  • Strategic Leadership: Lead end-to-end administrative operations for the South America fulfillment region. Design, implement, and refine regional administrative strategies and SOPs to ensure high efficiency and full compliance with local regulations.
  • Budget & Cost Control: Oversee the regional administrative budget. Drive cost-efficiency through meticulous expenditure management, covering office procurement, facility rentals, corporate events, and operational overheads.
  • Facility & Logistics Oversight: Direct comprehensive facility services and logistics, including canteen operations, shuttle bus services, janitorial standards, and conference management to maintain an organized and high-standard workplace.
  • Expatriate & Employee Support: Manage administrative support for expatriate employees and organize corporate events to foster a positive, inclusive, and productive office culture.
  • Supply Chain & Asset Management: Spearhead the lifecycle management of administrative supplies, equipment, and fixed assets. This includes strategic vendor selection, procurement negotiation, and conducting regular audits to ensure asset integrity.
  • Experience Optimization: Continuously analyze and upgrade administrative service quality to enhance the overall employee experience and operational agility.

Qualifications

  • Major preferably in Administrative Management, Business Administration, or related fields;
  • More than 5 years of experience in administrative management, with at least 3 years of team management experience;
  • Experience in large manufacturing industries or parks is preferred;
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese as working languages; knowledge of Chinese is preferred but not mandatory;
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills, ability to work under pressure, strong sense of responsibility, attention to detail, cost consciousness, and service-oriented mindset;
  • Outstanding negotiation, project management, and team management skills.



CAREERS AT SHEIN

We Commit to Inclusion

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

We Empower Talents with Diverse Careers

At SHEIN, we empower talent to excel with regular opportunities to elevate their career in their respective fields. As a dynamic business, we support internal mobility, diverse career pathways and recognition of success and contribution in a variety of meaningful ways.

We Engage with Global Cultures

SHEIN has over 20 offices worldwide , providing talent with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues around the world. Perspective sharing and leveraging cultural differences, is one of our core strenghts as we work on many exciting projects and draw insights from industry-leading experience.

title: Gerente Regional de Vendas
description:
A Fugini é uma empresa brasileira de alimentos, líder nos segmentos de molhos de tomate e vegetais, que iniciou sua trajetória há quase 30 anos na cidade de Monte Alto, interior de São Paulo. Com atuação totalmente voltada ao mercado nacional, seus produtos estão presentes em todas as regiões do país. Atualmente, a companhia opera com duas unidades fabris equipadas com modernos sistemas de automação: uma em Monte Alto (SP) e outra em Cristalina (GO), inaugurada em 2010 e com 33 mil metros quadrados de área construída. Comprometida em oferecer produtos saudáveis e com rótulo limpo (clean label), a empresa não utiliza conservantes artificiais e promoveu a redução de sal, açúcar e gordura na maioria de suas formulações. Seu portfólio inclui molhos de tomate, vegetais em sachês e latas, molhos especiais, condimentos e outros itens desenvolvidos sob rigorosos padrões de qualidade e segurança alimentar. Para saber mais, acesse fugini.com.br.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Remote

ASAP HIRE



We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to help design, build, and operate reliable cloud infrastructure systems. This role is hands-on and operational in nature, with a strong focus on infrastructure as code, cloud services, and continuous delivery. You’ll work closely with engineering and platform teams to ensure our infrastructure is secure, scalable, and maintainable.

This is a highly collaborative role suited for someone who enjoys balancing delivery with operational excellence in a fast-moving environment.


What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure using infrastructure‑as‑code practices
  • Support and improve Kubernetes-based platforms, containerized workloads, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Build and operate AWS-based infrastructure using services such as Lambda, API Gateway, AWS Transfer Family, RDS, and S3
  • Partner with engineering teams to improve reliability, scalability, security, and cost efficiency
  • Support identity and access workflows, including SAML-based integrations
  • Contribute to technical documentation, design decisions, and operational runbooks
  • Prioritize and manage work in a Kanban-style operational environment with competing demands


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and networking fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containers, and CI/CD systems in real-world environments
  • Practical experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, including modules, state management, and multi-environment deployments
  • Solid understanding of operational concerns such as system reliability, scalability, security, and cost
  • Experience building and supporting AWS infrastructure
  • Experience using GitHub Actions to support CI/CD workflows
  • Strong understanding of identity concepts, including authentication, authorization, and SAML
  • Strong written communication skills, especially for technical documentation and design explanations
  • Ability to prioritize work effectively and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously


Nice to Have

  • Experience with tools such as Netlify, Okta, Apache Kafka, or Redis
  • Background working on platform or developer enablement teams
  • Experience supporting infrastructure in regulated or compliance-focused environments

title: Platform Engineer / DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer / DevOps Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Overview

We’re hiring a hands-on Platform / DevOps Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a “boots-on-the-ground” execution role —not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably.


You’ll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement .


What You’ll Do

  • Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup)
  • Manage Kubernetes environments : deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting
  • Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI preferred; Jenkins/GitHub Actions acceptable)
  • Maintain and improve self-service workflows , templates, and developer “golden paths”
  • Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, OpenTelemetry ) to monitor systems and improve signal quality
  • Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing
  • Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs
  • Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response
  • Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability
  • Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)


Must-Have Requirements

  • 6+ years in Platform Engineering / DevOps / SRE / Infrastructure roles
  • Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, CloudWatch, etc.)
  • Deep Kubernetes expertise :
  • Operating and maintaining clusters
  • Experience building Kubernetes environments
  • Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
  • Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling
  • Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong Linux fundamentals
  • Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GitLab CI
  • Exposure to OpenTelemetry
  • API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java)
  • Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers)
  • Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows
  • Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS)
  • Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations


What We’re NOT Looking For

  • No Kubernetes experience ❌
  • Bash-only engineers (no Python) ❌
  • Pure consulting/advisory profiles ❌
  • Pure security-focused candidates ❌
  • Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ❌
  • ML/Data Science profiles ❌


Team Structure

  • 1 Principal Engineer
  • 1 Senior Engineer
  • 1 Engineer (India)
  • You = 4th key team member

description:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems.   • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.

  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams.

title: Gerente Administrativo
description:
Gerente Administrativo – Clínica de Grande Porte (Recife/PE)


Você não está sendo contratado para “organizar o administrativo”.


Você está sendo contratado para assumir uma parte relevante da operação da clínica — com impacto direto em resultado financeiro, relacionamento com convênios, segurança jurídica e estabilidade da equipe.

Somos uma clínica com aproximadamente 150 colaboradores, em crescimento, com operação complexa e alto volume de atendimentos. Precisamos de alguém que não execute tarefas, mas que pense, organize e conduza.


Responsabilidades do cargo


Você será responsável por estruturar, acompanhar e evoluir quatro pilares centrais da clínica:


1. Financeiro e Lucratividade

Apresentar mensalmente os indicadores financeiros da clínica

Identificar desperdícios, distorções e gargalos operacionais

Propor e acompanhar ações concretas de melhoria de resultado

Apoiar a direção na tomada de decisão com base em números


2. Faturamento e Convênios (ANS / Planos de Saúde)

Acompanhar indicadores de faturamento

Atuar diretamente na redução de glosas

Estruturar e melhorar o relacionamento com operadoras

Organizar processos de envio, conferência e recurso de contas


3. Jurídico e Compliance

Acompanhar processos judiciais da clínica

Fazer interface com o escritório jurídico

Garantir cumprimento de prazos e obrigações legais

Atuar preventivamente em situações de risco


4. Gestão de Pessoas

Estruturar plano estratégico de gestão de pessoas

Atuar na redução de rotatividade

Desenvolver lideranças internas

Melhorar o ambiente de trabalho de forma prática


O perfil que buscamos:

  • Experiência sólida em gestão administrativa na área da saúde
  • Vivência com faturamento de convênios e relacionamento com operadoras
  • Capacidade de leitura de indicadores e tomada de decisão
  • Organização e acompanhamento de processos jurídicos
  • Experiência real em gestão de equipes
  • Postura de dono, sem depender de comando constante
  • O que não funciona nesse cargo
  • Perfil operacional que espera ordens
  • Falta de domínio em convênios e faturamento
  • Dificuldade com números e indicadores
  • Gestão de pessoas baseada apenas em conversa, sem método


Modelo de remuneração

Fixo: R$ 10.000,00

Até R$ 2.000,00 de premiação variável por performance (4 metas):


1. Meta Financeira

Apresentação consistente de indicadores + propostas implementadas de melhoria de lucratividade

2. Meta de Faturamento

Redução de glosas + melhoria de processos + fortalecimento do relacionamento com operadoras

3. Meta Jurídica

Acompanhamento ativo dos processos + acionamento adequado do jurídico + cumprimento das obrigações legais

4. Meta de Gestão de Pessoas

Redução de rotatividade + evolução do clima organizacional + desenvolvimento das lideranças


A remuneração variável está diretamente ligada à entrega real, não à intenção.


Consideração final﻿

Essa não é uma vaga para quem quer estabilidade.

É uma vaga para quem quer assumir responsabilidade, organizar uma operação grande e crescer junto com a clínica.

Se você já fez isso antes, vai se destacar rápido.

Se ainda não fez, provavelmente não é o momento.
